suppress.notes: False-positive CPE association: the internal Maven module io.github.fturleque:morpheus-store-sqlite:1.2.1 is MORPHEUS code, not SQLite 1.2.1. The actual runtime driver is independently scanned as org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc:3.53.4.0. base="true" exempts this rule from failBuildOnUnusedSuppressionRule, and only this rule: whether the association happens depends on the history of the vulnerability database. The long-lived CI database makes it; a database built from scratch, by the NVD API or by the NVD data feeds, files cpe:/a:sqlite:sqlite under the native ecosystem and does not (measured with Dependency-Check 13.0.0 on 2026-10-28). The rule must therefore not fail the scan when it matches nothing. See RT-13 in docs/architecture/risks/register.md.

False-positive CPE association introduced by the aggregate coverage module: io.github.fturleque:morpheus-cli:1.2.1 is the MORPHEUS command-line adapter, not GitHub CLI 1.2.1. This rule removes only the github:cli CPE from that exact internal package URL; all third-party dependencies of morpheus-cli remain scanned.
